name: GitHub
changes: Three tools for an agent working a pull-request step: create-pull-request opens one from a pushed branch (or finds the open one), pull-request-status says how one stands with its address, complete-pull-request merges it by the method asked.
description: Daoris's work on GitHub through its REST API, with the token its own login keeps: pull-request opens a GitHub pull request from the branch Daoris pushed and reads its state.

commands.name: login
commands.about: Keeps a GitHub token for its REST API in this plugin's own storage.

commands.name: status
commands.about: Says whether a token is kept, since when, and whether GitHub last refused it.

about.en: Opens a GitHub pull request from a pushed branch into its target (the repository's default branch where none is named), or finds the open one; its data is the pull request's number, address and state.
about.zh: 从已推送的分支向目标分支（未指定则为仓库默认分支）创建 GitHub 拉取请求，已有打开的则直接找到；数据为拉取请求的编号、地址和状态。

about.en: Says whether a pull request, named by its address or number or found from its branch, is open, completed (merged) or abandoned, with its address and merge commit as data.
about.zh: 说明一个拉取请求（按地址或编号指定，或从其分支找到）是打开、已完成（已合并）还是已放弃，数据含地址和合并提交。

title.zh: 拉取请求的地址或编号

about.en: Merges an open pull request by the method asked (merge where none is), its branch protection still deciding; one already merged is said so.
about.zh: 按所要求的方式（未指定则为合并）合并打开的拉取请求，仍由分支保护决定；已合并的会如实说明。

title.zh: 拉取请求的地址或编号

storage.for: The token login keeps, and when GitHub last refused it.

about.en: Opens a GitHub pull request from the branch Daoris pushed to origin, or finds the one already open for it. It sends nothing but its API calls, with the token its own login keeps.
about.zh: 从 Daoris 已推送到 origin 的分支创建 GitHub 拉取请求，已有未关闭的则直接沿用。只发送它的 API 请求，使用它自己登录时保存的令牌。

tools.for: Runs the plugin's plugin.mjs, and its calls to GitHub's REST API (fetch).
